headline: England's Littler and Humphries win the World Cup of Darts in Frankfurt
standfirst: Luke Littler and Luke Humphries won the World Cup of Darts for England, beating the Netherlands' Michael van Gerwen and Gian van Veen in the final.
body: England won the 2026 World Cup of Darts in Frankfurt, with Luke Littler and Luke Humphries beating the Netherlands pair of Michael van Gerwen and Gian van Veen in the final at the Eissporthalle. The English pair averaged 104.77 in the final, the highest of the tournament.

England's toughest test came in the quarter-finals, where they edged Wales' Jonny Clayton and Nick Kenny 8-7. That match included a 170 checkout from the English team. They then beat Scotland's Gary Anderson and Cameron Menzies 8-3 in the semi-finals, averaging 101.59.

The Dutch reached the final with an 8-4 quarter-final win over Germany's Ricardo Pietreczko and Martin Schindler, averaging 102.68. They followed it with an 8-2 semi-final win over Northern Ireland's Daryl Gurney and Josh Rock.
Scotland beat Ireland 8-5 in their quarter-final. Northern Ireland edged Latvia 8-7.
England hit 23 maximums across the tournament, the most of any team, ahead of the Netherlands on 16.
